scene: The tapped glass zaps, waking rooftop transports idling along the misty rim.
picture: A flat side view along a rooftop landing. At far left, an eight-legged metal bridge crawler waits by a gantry. To the left stands the middle-aged Black man with grey beard, burnt-orange corduroy jacket and brass telescope. In the centre sits a brass mail train with open hatch. On far right idles a hovering tow truck.
shown: a mechanical multi-legged crawler vehicle waiting on track rails at far left
a brass pneumatic mail train with open passenger hatch at centre
a yellow hovering tow truck idling by the curb on far right
